input: Unfair discrimination and misrepresentation is a risk associated with An AI system is designed to select relevant images for news stories, aiming to provide accurate and informative visual content. The system uses algorithms to match images with corresponding articles, intending to enhance the reader's experience. It strives to improve the efficiency and precision of image selection for news publications.
